_labels.walk_in_details_for_burari_hospital_recr: Walk-in details for Burari Hospital Recruitment 2026

content_sections.heading: Key Points
content_sections.text: Walk-in date: 5 December 2026, reporting at 9:00 AM Vacancies: 1 (UR 0, OBC 1, SC 0, ST 0) How to apply: Attend the walk-in interview Pay: As per 7th CPC guidelines as adopted by GNCT of Delhi; amount not printed Fee: No application fee is mentioned in the notification Age limit: Maximum 45 years (as on date of interview) Place: Burari Hospital, Kaushik Enclave, Delhi

content_sections.heading: Burari Hospital Senior Resident (ENT) Recruitment 2026 - Overview
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

rows.burari_hospital_govt_of_nct_of_delhi: As per 7th CPC guidelines as adopted by GNCT of Delhi; amount not printed
MBBS with post graduate degree/DNB/Diploma or equivalent as per Residency Scheme in ENT from a recognized University/Institute on the day of interview; Delhi Medical Council registration
Maximum 45 years (as on date of interview)

content_sections.heading: Burari Hospital Senior Resident (ENT) Walk-in Interview Date, Time and Venue
content_sections.text: Venue: Office of Medical Director, Burari Hospital, Kaushik Enclave, Burari, Delhi - 110084. Candidates should report between 9:00 AM and 11:00 AM; entry is allowed up to 11 AM.

content_sections.heading: Burari Hospital Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. BH/Resident/Advt-17/SR/11/2026 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download Burari Hospital notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: MBBS with post graduate degree/DNB/Diploma or equivalent as per Residency Scheme in concerned specialty from a recognized University/Institute on the day of interview; In case of non-availability of MD/DNB certificate, candidates with 02 years experience in the concerned department are considered on ad-hoc basis; Must be registered with Delhi Medical Council on or before the day of interview Experience: Must not have completed 03 years as Senior Resident from any recognized institute, regular or ad-hoc Age limit: Maximum 45 years (as on date of interview) Age relaxation: SC/ST Up to 5 years, OBC (Non Creamy Layer, belonging to Delhi only) 3 years Other conditions: Must be registered with Delhi Medical Council with MBBS and requisite postgraduate qualification, with valid DMC certificate or applied for PG degree/diploma DMC on the date of interview Candidates to follow social distancing and wear a mask No TA/DA is paid for participating in the selection process

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for Burari Hospital Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates who have completed 03 years as Senior Resident from any recognized institute, regular or ad-hoc OBC applicants unable to show valid proof at document verification are rejected and not allowed for interview

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Pay as per 7th CPC guidelines as adopted by GNCT of Delhi; no amount printed. Ad-hoc appointment for 44 days or till a regular candidate joins Extendable up to a maximum of three years on satisfactory Work & Conduct report from the concerned HOD and written request from the SR Total Senior Resident tenure maximum three years, including tenure in other govt./govt. funded institutions Contract can be terminated by either party with one month's notice without assigning any reason Appointment subject to medical fitness and verification of certificates

content_sections.heading: How Will Burari Hospital Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Merit list based on walk-in interview Document verification with originals on the day of interview Result displayed on Delhi Government website and hospital notice board Selection is purely as per merit list based on the walk-in interview A panel of wait-listed candidates is prepared for future SR vacancies, valid 6 months or till fresh selection, whichever is earlier Separate lists are prepared for fresh candidates and those shortlisted under relaxed criteria

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Prefilled printed application form and two passport photos X class certificate (for date of birth) Attempt Certificate Degree (MBBS and post graduate degree/DNB or Diploma) Experience certificate if applicable; Aadhaar Card/Voter ID/Passport; publications (indexed journal only) Delhi OBC (Non creamy) certificate for OBC candidates

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Burari Hospital Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Fill the application form through the Google Forms link or QR code given in the notice. Check the auto-generated email (also trash/spam) containing the prefilled application form. Take a printout of the prefilled form. Report at the Office of Medical Director, Burari Hospital on 05-12-2026 between 9 AM and 11 AM with the printout, two passport photos, self-attested photocopies and originals.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Number of posts is provisional and subject to change without any notice The post is reserved for OBC (Delhi Non Creamy Layer); if no candidate is available in the reserved category, candidates from other categories are considered on ad-hoc basis for 44 days If the interview date is declared a holiday, the schedule shifts to the next working day or as decided by the Medical Director Decision of Selection Board/Medical Director is final and binding No letter or personal information is issued for results

faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for Burari Hospital Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 5 December 2026, and candidates report at 9:00 AM.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Burari Hospital Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Senior Resident (ENT), reserved for OBC (Delhi Non Creamy Layer).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for Burari Hospital Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 5 December 2026 at 9:00 AM. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 45 years (as on date of interview). Relaxation: SC/ST Up to 5 years, OBC (Non Creamy Layer, belonging to Delhi only) 3 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: As per 7th CPC guidelines as adopted by GNCT of Delhi; amount not printed.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: MBBS with post graduate degree/DNB/Diploma or equivalent as per Residency Scheme in ENT from a recognized University/Institute on the day of interview; Delhi Medical Council registration.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Must be registered with Delhi Medical Council with MBBS and requisite postgraduate qualification, with valid DMC certificate or applied for PG degree/diploma DMC on the date of interview. Candidates to follow social distancing and wear a mask. No TA/DA is paid for participating in the selection process.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates who have completed 03 years as Senior Resident from any recognized institute, regular or ad-hoc. OBC applicants unable to show valid proof at document verification are rejected and not allowed for interview.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Merit list based on walk-in interview. Document verification with originals on the day of interview. Result displayed on Delhi Government website and hospital notice board. Selection is purely as per merit list based on the walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Ad-hoc appointment for 44 days or till a regular candidate joins. Extendable up to a maximum of three years on satisfactory Work & Conduct report from the concerned HOD and written request from the SR. Total Senior Resident tenure maximum three years, including tenure in other govt./govt. funded institutions.
